comments: Seems reasonable. Want to put together a PR?

Yeah this would be a good improvement. Although, rather than `get_kind_info` maybe we should call it `get_represented_kind_info` since it's the info of the represented type that we want (and for parity with the method on `Reflect`).

> Seems reasonable. Want to put together a PR?

Taking a look.

> maybe we should call it `get_represented_kind_info`

Sounds good

I did a draft of the impl for struct. Is `Option<&KindInfo>` ok? I see `TypeInfoError` exists too.

If the quick draft doesn't raise any immediate concerns I'll add impls for the other kinds

review_comments: Docs isn't consistent with the other methods, is there a reason that here we have this second line but in other places not?

In doc comments I've seen in Bevy the convention is to prefer the shorter syntax without path qualifiers.
But doing so requires the type to be in scope.
This file did not have `TypeInfo` in scope, the others did.
Rust allows bringing types into scope via the syntax you see on the last line.
